variantes: Child’s pose with arms alongside the body
Posture with cushion under the stomach
Dynamic posture with back and forth

consignes.Positionnement: Kneel on the mat, big toes touching, knees apart. Sit on your heels and lean your torso forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arms far in front or leave them at your sides. Completely relaxes your neck, shoulders and back.
consignes.Retour: Stay in the pose for as long as desired, then slowly stand up.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly and deeply through your nose, concentrate on releasing it.
consignes.Posture: Rounded back, pelvis close to the heels, forehead on the ground.

C002.nom: Standing forward bend with straight legs
variantes: Slightly bent knees for beginners
Dynamic forward bend
With grip of opposite elbows

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your feet hip width apart. Take a deep breath, then as you exhale, slowly lean forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the torso fall towards the legs, relax the head and arms. Try to touch the ground or your shins.
consignes.Retour: Stay in the posture for the expected time. To return, gently unwind the spine.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale through your nose, exhale slowly to release tension.
consignes.Posture: Back relaxed, body weight slightly forward, neck relaxed.

C003.nom: Lying overall stretch with straight arms (extension on the floor)
contraintes: Do not arch your lower back
variantes: Active extension with pushed toes
Crossover Stretch with Opposite Arms and Legs
With guided yawn

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms extended above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Move your hands and feet in two opposite directions as if you want to grow taller.
consignes.Retour: Release after a few seconds of stretching, then repeat if necessary.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while stretching, exhale while releasing.
consignes.Posture: Arms in line with the ears, trunk stretched without excessive tension.

C004.nom: Gentle twist lying on the floor
contraintes: Shoulders in contact with the ground
variantes: Cross or cactus arms
One leg straight, the other bent
With cushion under the knees

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your arms crossed. Bend your knees and gently rock them to one side.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your knees lower toward the floor while keeping your shoulders well rested.
consignes.Retour: Stay in the position, then slowly return to center before switching sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the center, exhale while releasing into the twist.
consignes.Posture: Head turned away from the knees, relaxed gaze.

C005.nom: Lying arm twist in a cross or cactus shape
contraintes: Shoulders firmly placed on the ground

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms crossed (or cactus position). Gently bring your knees to one side.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your knees drop to the ground, arms wide open. Hold without forcing.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center, change sides after the scheduled time.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the center, exhale into the twist to release.
consignes.Posture: Head turned away from the knees, shoulders fixed.

C006.nom: Lying twist with one leg straight, the other bent

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, extend one leg to the floor, bend the other and pass it over your body.
consignes.Mouvement: Guide the bent knee towards the ground on the opposite side without lifting the shoulder.
consignes.Retour: Stay twisted, then slowly come back and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale slowly into the twist.
consignes.Posture: Arms crossed, gaze away from the knee.

C007.nom: Lying twist with cushion under the knees

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your knees bent together on a cushion placed on one side.
consignes.Mouvement: Release your legs on the support, keeping your shoulders on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Stay in the pose, then gently bring your legs back to center.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, abdominal breathing.
consignes.Posture: Arms open, gaze away from the legs.

variantes: Dynamic downward facing dog
Downward facing dog with bent knees
Downward facing dog against a wall

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, then push your hips upward to form an inverted V.
consignes.Mouvement: Lengthen your back, push your heels toward the floor and relax your head between your arms.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the expected time, then return to the initial position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while stretching, exhale while releasing tension.
consignes.Posture: Hands well anchored, arms and legs straight but without locking.

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt the downward facing dog position.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend one knee then the other alternately to stretch each leg in turn.
consignes.Retour: Return to a static position or place your knees on the floor to finish.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on one leg, exhale on the other.
consignes.Posture: Body in inverted V, heels towards the ground.

C010.nom: Downward facing dog with bent knees
contraintes: Priority flat back with straight leg

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in downward facing dog with your knees slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Keep your arms and back stretched while bending your knees to reduce tension.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position or place your knees on the floor.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, relaxed breathing.
consignes.Posture: Heels relaxed, neck relaxed, back stretched.

C011.nom: Downward facing dog against a wall

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the wall, an arm’s length away. Place your hands on the wall and lean your torso until you form a right angle.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch your arms and push your hips back to stretch your back and shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, straightening yourself vertebra by vertebra.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while stretching, exhale while releasing.
consignes.Posture: Head aligned with the arms, legs semi-flexed if necessary.

variantes: Dynamic frog (basin back and forth)
Frog on cushion or soft support
Frog legs wider apart (advanced)

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, then slowly spread your knees, keeping your feet in line with them.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower your pelvis towards the ground without arching your back.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position, then gently bring your knees together to come out of the pose.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply, releasing with each exhale.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, gaze forward or at the ground, shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in a classic frog position with your knees apart and your shins parallel.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform small back and forth movements of the pelvis to gently mobilize the hips.
consignes.Retour: After several repetitions, return to center and release.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going backwards, exhale while coming back.
consignes.Posture: Stable trunk, movement initiated by the pelvis.

C014.nom: Frog on cushion or soft support
contraintes: Cushion placed under the knees or ankles

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in classic frog pose, with a cushion under your knees to relieve the joint.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the posture by gradually releasing the pelvis towards the ground.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your knees together to come out of the position.
consignes.Respiration: Breathing calm and fluid.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, relaxed pelvis, comfortable support.

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt the frog pose, then slowly increase the width of your knees.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the pelvis descend as far as possible without loss of posture.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your knees together.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, release as you exhale.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, distributed support, intense but controlled stretching.

C016.nom: Lateral tilt standing with arms overhead
variantes: Recline with crossed arms
Dynamic tilt
Tilt with wall support

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Raise your arms above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt your torso to the side without leaning forward or backward.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to center, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the center, exhale into the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Gaze straight, arms outstretched, flank stretched.

C017.nom: Lateral tilt standing with crossed arms
variantes: Cross recline with arm extended to one side only
Arms crossed behind the head

consignes.Positionnement: Stand, cross your wrists and raise your arms above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly tilt your torso to the side while keeping your arms crossed.
consignes.Retour: Return to center, then do the tilt to the other side.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the side stretch.
consignes.Posture: Fixed gaze, straight torso, arms slightly outstretched.

variantes: Dynamic tilt crossed arms
Dynamic tilt with light weights

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your arms alongside your body or raised above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform alternating lateral tilts without forcing, in a controlled rhythm.
consignes.Retour: Return to center after each movement.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the center, exhale during each inclination.
consignes.Posture: Stable bust, movement controlled by the obliques.

C019.nom: Lateral tilt standing with wall support
contraintes: Arms overhead or along the wall
variantes: Wall support with flexed arms
Lateral extended arm wall support

consignes.Positionnement: Stand next to a wall with your outer arm raised above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently lean toward the wall to stretch the opposite side.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center then change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when stretching, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Fixed hips, pure lateral movement.

C020.nom: Crossed stretch opposite arms and legs
variantes: Crossed arm held with the other hand
Raised leg on support
Dynamic version with slow back and forth

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your arms crossed. Bring one straight or bent leg to the opposite side.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the leg go down to the ground on the opposite side of the arm, while keeping the shoulders on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center, then change sides after the allotted time.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the twist to release further.
consignes.Posture: Gaze away from the leg, shoulders relaxed, pelvis relaxed.

C021.nom: Cross stretch with opposite arm support
variantes: Supported by the forearm instead of the hand
Using an elastic band

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your arms crossed. Gently grasp the opposite arm with the hand on the side of the bent leg.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your arm slightly to increase the stretch in the twist.
consignes.Retour: Release your arm and slowly return to center.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when twisting, release when exhaling.
consignes.Posture: Hips and shoulders firmly placed on the ground.

C022.nom: Raised leg crossed stretch on support
objectifs: Controlled stretching of the lower back and glutes
variantes: Support under the knee or ankle depending on comfort
With open arm on the ground

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, place the bent leg on the opposite side on a block or cushion.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the weight of the leg sink into the support while keeping the shoulders on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your leg back to center, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale long to accentuate the relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Arm crossed or opposite hand on the knee.

C023.nom: Dynamic crossover stretching (controlled back and forth)
variantes: Increasing amplitude on each repetition
Arms crossed on chest

consignes.Positionnement: Lie down with your arms crossed, your legs bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll your knees from side to side, keeping your shoulders on the floor.
consignes.Retour: Stay a few seconds on each side before returning.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the center, exhale into the movement.
consignes.Posture: Head aligned, pelvis relaxed, fluid movement.

contraintes: No tension in the lower back
variantes: With cushions under the knees
With arms crossed or above the head
Dynamic version with slow opening/closing of the legs

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees open outwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Completely relax your legs and arms, breathe slowly.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your knees together with your hands, without forcing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale through your nose, exhale slowly through your mouth to release further.
consignes.Posture: Relaxed back, relaxed shoulders, long neck.

C025.nom: Lying butterfly stretch with cushions under the knees
contraintes: No tension in the lower back
variantes: Include a blanket on the stomach to reinforce the feeling of security
Arms crossed or along the body

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, soles of your feet touching, place a cushion under each knee.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the legs open naturally, without constraint thanks to the supports.
consignes.Retour: Bring your knees together gently with your hands.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and calmly, releasing tension with each exhale.
consignes.Posture: Back flat, shoulders relaxed, support symmetrical.

C026.nom: Lying butterfly stretch with arms crossed or overhead
contraintes: Arms relaxed, without tension in the trapezius
variantes: Arms crossed on the floor
Arms extended overhead on the floor

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with butterfly legs. Extend your arms crosswise or overhead.
consignes.Mouvement: Release the whole body to the ground, without forcing.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arms back first, then your knees.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, deep breathing, synchronized with posture.
consignes.Posture: Body open, relaxed, extended like a soft star.

variantes: Slow opening then short hold
Feet away from the pelvis for more flexibility

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, feet together, knees bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly open and close your knees in a regular rhythm.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position once the repetitions have been completed.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale when closing, exhale when opening.
consignes.Posture: Back pressed to the ground, pelvis stable, shoulders relaxed.

C028.nom: Stretching legs against a wall (Viparita Karani)
variantes: Legs slightly apart against the wall
Legs bent at 90° against the wall
With cushion under the pelvis for gentle inversion

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back near a wall, glutes as close as possible, legs extended upwards against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Completely relax your legs, arms alongside your body or crosswise.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your legs back to the floor by sliding your feet along the wall.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly, increasing relaxation with each exhalation.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, pelvis placed or slightly elevated, gaze towards the ceiling.

C029.nom: Stretching legs against a wall – legs apart
variantes: With arms on the ground for chest opening
With cushions under the hips

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your legs extended towards the wall, then gently open them to each side.
consignes.Mouvement: Let gravity gently spread your legs.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your legs together with your hands if necessary.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply.
consignes.Posture: Back flat, hips open without forcing.

C030.nom: Stretching legs against a wall – legs bent
variantes: With cushion under the head or pelvis
With arms crossed on the stomach

consignes.Positionnement: Lie close to the wall, legs bent with feet flat against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Release your legs in this position while maintaining the angle of your knees.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower your legs to the side.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe smoothly and calmly.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, shoulders relaxed, pelvis on the ground.

C031.nom: Stretching legs against a wall – with cushion under the pelvis
variantes: With legs apart
With cross arms to open the rib cage

consignes.Positionnement: Place a cushion or bolster under the pelvis before placing your legs against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your legs rest against the wall, pelvis slightly elevated.
consignes.Retour: Remove the cushion before lowering your legs.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly and deeply, without straining.
consignes.Posture: Back extended, pelvis supported, legs relaxed.

variantes: With cushion under the knees or head
With arms crossed on the chest
With more or less wide opening of the arms and legs

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, legs slightly apart, arms open in a V at approximately 45° from the body.
consignes.Mouvement: No movement required, complete release.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your legs together, roll onto your side to stand up.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply through your nose, exhale slowly through your mouth, without forcing.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ceiling or eyes closed, body symmetrical and relaxed.

C033.nom: Lying star stretch with cushion under the knees or head
contraintes: Cushion well centered under the support points
variantes: Cushion only under the knees
Cushion under the neck and knees together

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, place a cushion under your knees or head depending on comfort.
consignes.Mouvement: Completely relax your legs and arms, let your body sink.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your arms and legs back to center, roll to one side to stand up straight.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale long and release with each breath.
consignes.Posture: Symmetrical body, stable support, relieved neck and lower back.

C034.nom: Lying star stretch with arms crossed over the torso
contraintes: Arms crossed without tension in the shoulders
variantes: Arm in X over heart
Alternate arms (left above then right)

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, cross your arms across your chest, hands on your shoulders or chest.
consignes.Mouvement: Remain still, completely relaxing your limbs.
consignes.Retour: Gently unfold your arms to rest them on the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, calm, abdominal breathing.
consignes.Posture: Body centered, shoulders relaxed, gaze towards the ceiling or eyes closed.

C035.nom: Elongated star stretch with modulated opening
variantes: Tight or very open V-arm
Legs more or less apart depending on comfort

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, spread your arms and legs slightly or widely depending on your flexibility.
consignes.Mouvement: None, relax the body in the chosen amplitude.
consignes.Retour: Gently close the arms and legs after the relaxation time.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale in relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Adapted amplitude, relaxed body, balanced support.

variantes: With cushion under the knees
With cover on the body
With audio guided relaxation

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, legs slightly apart, arms alongside your body, palms facing the sky.
consignes.Mouvement: No movement. Let the body relax completely into the ground.
consignes.Retour: Start by moving your fingers and toes, then slowly stretch before turning to the side to stand up.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, regular, silent breathing. Just observe your breath.
consignes.Posture: Body totally relaxed, gaze inward, mind peaceful.

C037.nom: Stretching calves against a wall (leg straight)
variantes: Flexed leg calf stretch (soleus)
Dynamic calf stretch against a wall
Calf stretching with step or walking

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing a wall, one leg back stretched with the heel on the ground, the other leg bent in front.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently push against the wall until you feel a stretch in the back calf.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the pressure, change legs after the scheduled time.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the start, exhale slowly while maintaining the position.
consignes.Posture: Hips aligned, back straight, gaze forward.

C038.nom: Stretching calves against a wall – leg flexed (soleus)
contraintes: Knee flexed on the back leg
variantes: With forward tilt of the bust
With both hands on the wall or just one

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the wall, back leg bent, heel firmly anchored to the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently push your knee toward the wall without lifting your heel.
consignes.Retour: Release the pressure, then change legs after the scheduled time.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis facing the wall, gaze fixed.

C039.nom: Dynamic calf stretch against a wall
contraintes: Heels always in contact with the ground
variantes: Slow flexion-extension of the rear knee
Back and forth mobility without pause

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the wall, back foot well anchored, perform small knee flexions.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently alternate between straight and bent legs.
consignes.Retour: After 10 to 15 repetitions, switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Fluid breathing, synchronized with movements.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, hips fixed.

C040.nom: Stretching calves on step or walking
contraintes: Heel well relaxed in the void
variantes: Bilateral or unilateral version
With support on a bar or wall

consignes.Positionnement: Place the forefoot on a step or a step, let the heel descend slowly into space.
consignes.Mouvement: Hold the position or perform light bounces if dynamic.
consignes.Retour: Return your foot to the step before releasing completely.
consignes.Respiration: Fluid breathing, accentuates relaxation with each exhalation.
consignes.Posture: Knee slightly bent, body well aligned, gaze straight.

C041.nom: Stretching calves on the floor with towel or strap
variantes: Stretching calves with bent leg on the floor
Lying calf stretcher with strap
Bilateral calf stretch with towel

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs outstretched and place a towel around the sole of one leg.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull the towel towards you to bring the tip of your foot towards your shin.
consignes.Retour: Gradually release the tension, then change legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale gently during the pull, inhale when releasing.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, legs aligned.

C042.nom: Calf stretch on the floor – leg bent (soleus)
variantes: With slight forward tilt of the bust

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with the knee of the stretched leg slightly bent, towel around the foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull on the towel to bring the tip of your toe toward you.
consignes.Retour: Gradually release tension.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly, exhale into the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Neutral pelvis, back extended.

variantes: With cushion under the head
With opposite leg bent

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your leg raised straight with the strap around your foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull the strap to bring the tip of your foot toward you.
consignes.Retour: Release the tension, rest the leg before changing sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale in the hold phase.
consignes.Posture: Back flat, pelvis neutral, shoulders relaxed.

variantes: Towel around both feet simultaneously
Extended version possible

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs straight, wrap the towel around both feet simultaneously.
consignes.Mouvement: Lightly pull the towel towards you to feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Release the tension gently.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply.
consignes.Posture: Back extended, shoulders relaxed, legs relaxed.

C045.nom: Calf stretch in wall lunge (back leg)
variantes: Extended Low Static Lunge
Dynamic lunge with controlled bounces
Lunge with raised arms for overall stretch

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in a lunge facing a wall, back leg straight, heel on the ground, arms against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the pelvis slightly forward to feel the stretch in the rear calf.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your back leg back and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply, exhaling slowly into the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis facing, fixed gaze, stable support.

C046.nom: Calf stretch in low static lunge
variantes: Without a supporting wall
With hands on hips or on the wall

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt a low lunge position, back leg straight, heel firmly anchored.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the position without moving for the expected duration.
consignes.Retour: Come up gently by bringing the back leg back.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and slowly.
consignes.Posture: Body straight, pelvis forward.

C047.nom: Calf stretch in dynamic lunge with rebounds
variantes: With arms akimbo or straight
With short pause after each bounce

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in a lunge with your back leg straight. Perform small forward bounces while keeping your heel on the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform light, repeated bends of the front knee.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position.
consignes.Respiration: Synchronize breathing with movements.
consignes.Posture: Stable body, gaze forward, pelvis facing.

C048.nom: Lunge calf stretch with arms raised
variantes: With arms parallel or slightly apart
With awareness of the breath in the posture

consignes.Positionnement: Lunge with rear leg straight, arms raised above head.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the position without moving, try to lengthen upwards.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arms back, then your legs.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while raising your arms, exhale while releasing tension.
consignes.Posture: Vertical alignment, stable hips, gaze far ahead.

C049.nom: Standing quadriceps stretch while pulling the foot
variantes: With support against a wall
Without support to work on balance
Lying on your side for greater comfort

consignes.Positionnement: Stand tall, grab your right foot with your right hand behind you.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull the heel toward the buttock without arching your lower back.
consignes.Retour: Gently release your leg before switching sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and regularly, releasing tension with each exhalation.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, knees aligned, pelvis neutral.

C050.nom: Quadriceps stretch lying on the side
variantes: With cushion under the head
With strap around the foot if necessary

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your left side, grab your right foot with your right hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull your heel toward your buttock, keeping your knees together.
consignes.Retour: Release your leg and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, deep breathing promotes relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, shoulders and hips overlapping.

C051.nom: Quadriceps stretch with strap or elastic
contraintes: Do not force with the elastic
variantes: Strap around the foot with progressive traction
Using a partner for support

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your stomach, tie a strap or elastic around your foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull on the strap to bring the heel closer to the buttock.
consignes.Retour: Release the tension slowly, change legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale slowly, releasing tension.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis on the ground, forehead resting or chin on the ground.

contraintes: Rear knee protected by a cushion if necessary
variantes: Torsion of the bust to accentuate the opening
Arm raised to the side of the rear leg

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a lunge on the floor, back leg placed, front leg bent at 90°.
consignes.Mouvement: Move your pelvis forward slightly without arching, option: grab your back foot.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each forward movement of the pelvis, inhale to maintain the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, look forward, shoulders relaxed.

C053.nom: Quadriceps stretch lying on your stomach
contraintes: Avoid lifting the pelvis off the ground
Grasp the foot gently without forcing
variantes: With cushion under the hips for greater comfort
With strap for beginners

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your stomach, grab your right foot with your right hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently bring the heel towards the buttock without forcing.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply while stretching.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis placed on the ground, shoulders relaxed.

variantes: Arm extended forward or upwards
Practical with support on the wall to start

consignes.Positionnement: Stand upright, grab your right foot with your right hand, left arm extended forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently push the foot against the hand while tilting the torso forward.
consignes.Retour: Bring the torso and leg back, release the foot gently.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you go up, exhale to maintain balance.
consignes.Posture: Fixed gaze, sheathed bust, stable pelvis.

C055.nom: Dynamic quadriceps heel-buttock stretching while walking
variantes: Alternating walk
Heel-butt in place while maintaining balance

consignes.Positionnement: While walking, alternately bring one heel towards the buttock while moving forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Briefly grab the foot with the hand on the same side to accentuate the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Continue alternating legs in a fluid manner.
consignes.Respiration: Natural, fluid and continuous breathing.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, look forward, steps controlled.

contraintes: Knee on the ground protected by a cushion or mat
variantes: Arms raised to accentuate the stretch
With support for balancing

consignes.Positionnement: Place one knee on the ground near the wall, with your shin resting vertically against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Gradually straighten your torso to feel the stretch in your thigh.
consignes.Retour: Lean forward slightly to release, then switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale to release tension.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis retroverted, back straight, shoulders relaxed.

C057.nom: Quadriceps stretch with TRX or straps
contraintes: Do not pull harshly on the straps
variantes: With support on one knee in a lunge
Standing position with foot in the strap

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the TRX, right foot in the strap behind you.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend the back knee to bring the heel towards the buttock, torso straight.
consignes.Retour: Straighten your leg gently to come out of the position, switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Calm and controlled breathing to promote relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Neutral pelvis, relaxed shoulders, light core.

C058.nom: Standing hamstring stretch in forward bend with straight legs
contraintes: Do not force your lower back
Keep your legs straight without locking your knees
variantes: With slight knee bend for beginners
With hands on a support to reduce the amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Stand upright, feet hip width apart, legs straight but not locked.
consignes.Mouvement: Lean forward, keeping your back straight for as long as possible, then relax your head and arms.
consignes.Retour: Gently unwind the spine to return to standing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while going down, inhale while maintaining the position.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis in slight retroversion, gradual relaxation of the upper body.

contraintes: Keep your back straight as long as possible
variantes: Flex foot for more tension on the calf
Tilt of the bust according to the amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot outstretched on an elevated surface in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently lean forward from the hips until you feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Slowly stand up and then switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale to maintain.
consignes.Posture: Square pelvis, straight back, shoulders aligned.

C060.nom: Seated hamstring stretch with straight legs
contraintes: Do not force your lower back
variantes: With strap around the feet
Straight back with small cushion under the buttocks

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs stretched out in front of you, back straight, feet flexed.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt your torso forward, reaching for your ankles or feet.
consignes.Retour: Straighten up slowly by unwinding the spine.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each advance, inhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis anchored, shoulders relaxed, neck relaxed.

contraintes: Keep the other leg on the ground or bent
Do not pull sharply on the strap
variantes: Leg on the wall if no strap
Knee slightly bent in case of stiffness

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor, the other raised with a strap around your foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull your leg towards you until you feel a stretch in the back of your thigh.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the tension and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale to slightly accentuate the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders on the ground, pelvis stable, gaze at the ceiling.

contraintes: Do not bend the front leg
variantes: More or less pronounced inclination depending on the level
Front foot slightly flexed for beginners

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with one foot placed in front of you on the ground or elevated, resting on the TRX straps.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt your torso forward while keeping your front leg straight.
consignes.Retour: Stand up slowly, switch legs after reps.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, light core, hips aligned.

C063.nom: Stretching hamstrings in straight front leg lunge
contraintes: Keep your back straight at the start of the movement
variantes: With cushion under the rear knee
With gentle front knee bend for beginners

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a low lunge, front leg straight with heel on the ground, torso straightened.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently lean forward to feel the stretch in the back of your thigh.
consignes.Retour: Return the bent front knee to return to a lunge, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the posture, exhale to release tension.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis aligned, shoulders relaxed.

C064.nom: Hamstring stretch with legs apart in splits
contraintes: Do not force in case of strong tensions
Respect the neutrality of the back
variantes: Tilt of the bust to the center or on one leg
With cushions under the knees for support

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs wide apart, toes pointing upwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt the bust forward or sideways depending on the variation chosen.
consignes.Retour: Gradually straighten your torso, then gently tighten your legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while going down, inhale into the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back as straight as possible, pelvis anchored, shoulders relaxed.

variantes: With hand support on the thighs for beginners
Arms toward the floor for a deeper stretch

consignes.Positionnement: Stand tall, cross one leg in front of the other.
consignes.Mouvement: Lean forward, keeping your legs straight (not locked) until you feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Slowly unwind your back and change your crossing leg.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the descent, inhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back relaxed, neck relaxed, legs stable.

C066.nom: Lying leg hamstring stretch against a wall
contraintes: Keep your buttocks close to the wall
variantes: Unilateral (one leg bent on the ground)
With towel or cushion under the basin

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, buttocks closest to the wall, legs extended upwards against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Completely relax your legs against the wall, without trying to pin them.
consignes.Retour: Gently bend your legs and roll onto your side to stand upright.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, deep breathing to relax the whole body.
consignes.Posture: Back to the ground, neck long, arms relaxed at each side.

variantes: Dynamic butterfly (knee beat)
Tilt your torso forward while keeping your back straight

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor, soles of your feet together, knees open to the sides.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull your feet toward you and release your knees toward the floor.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the posture and gently straighten your legs in front of you.
consignes.Respiration: Calm and regular breathing, relaxation on the exhale.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, low shoulders, stable pelvis.

contraintes: Straight back, avoid excessive rounding of the back
variantes: Center or single leg recline
Using blocks to relieve leaning

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs wide apart, toes pointing upwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt your torso forward or sideways, maintaining an elongated back.
consignes.Retour: Gently straighten the torso, tighten the legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale slowly as you descend, inhale into the posture.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis anchored to the ground, shoulders relaxed.

contraintes: Knee bent in line with toes
variantes: Static or dynamic lunge
With hands on the ground for support

consignes.Positionnement: Spread your legs in a wide squat position, then shift the weight to one side.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down on one leg while keeping the other straight, glutes facing back.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heel to return to center, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while going down, inhale into the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back straight or slightly inclined, gaze forward.

contraintes: Align your hips and knees at 90°
variantes: With cushions under the knees for greater comfort
Dynamic version with small forward/backward movements

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on all fours, knees as wide as possible, feet facing outwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your hips towards the floor, keeping your back neutral, rest on your forearms.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your knees together while pushing on your hands.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the position, exhale to deepen the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis aligned, shoulders relaxed.

C071.nom: Stretching adductors standing with leg outstretched to the side
contraintes: Do not bend the knee of the straight leg
variantes: With support (wall or bar) for balance
Dynamic movement for warming up

consignes.Positionnement: Stand up, spread your legs wide, then bend one leg while keeping the other stretched out to the side.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your pelvis, keeping your heel on the ground, feel the stretch on your outstretched leg.
consignes.Retour: Go up slowly and alternate sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, gaze forward, stable support.

C072.nom: Stretching adductors seated on bench or step
contraintes: Support under the glutes if needed
variantes: Forward tilt of the bust
Feet internally rotated to accentuate the stretch

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench or step, legs apart and straight in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt your torso forward with your back straight, until you feel a stretch.
consignes.Retour: Slowly stand up and bring your legs back.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the posture, exhale to release.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis slightly forward, shoulders relaxed.

C073.nom: Adductor stretching with TRX or straps
variantes: Static or dynamic position
Foot in the strap for more amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the anchor point, one leg stretched sideways resting on the strap.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend the supporting leg to descend gently, keeping the leg extended to the side.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, trunk engaged, stable support.

C074.nom: Stretching abductors lying with the knee crossed on the floor
objectifs: Stretching of the outer side chain
variantes: With opposite outstretched arm to accentuate the twist
With knee bent at 90° or leg straight

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms crossed.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring one knee towards your chest then slowly move it to the other side, placing it on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your leg back to neutral position and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale to release into the twist.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder opposite the ground, look towards the outstretched arm.

C075.nom: Cross leg standing abductor stretch with lateral tilt
variantes: Arms above head or at waist
With support on a wall for more stability

consignes.Positionnement: Cross one leg behind the other, arm on the same side stretched above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend sideways toward the back leg to stretch the opposite side.
consignes.Retour: Slowly stand up and then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the tilt, inhale during the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis stable, shoulders relaxed.

C076.nom: Seated abductor stretch with legs apart with lateral tilt
variantes: Arm overhead or extended toward opposite leg
Using a hand support

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs apart and your back straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Tilt your torso sideways towards one leg, opposite arm above your head or towards your foot.
consignes.Retour: Slowly stand up and then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the inclination, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, shoulders aligned, gaze upwards or to the ground.

contraintes: Supportive knee aligned with the foot
variantes: Hands on the ground for balance
Dynamic position with small bounces

consignes.Positionnement: Spread your legs in a wide squat, then shift your weight onto one leg by bending your knee, the other leg remains straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently push the hips toward the side of the bent leg.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, gaze forward, support well distributed.

C078.nom: Abductor stretching with TRX or straps
contraintes: Maintain good support on the ground
variantes: Foot in strap or hand-guided movement

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the anchor point, leg extended outwards in the strap.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the leg swing out to the side to open the hip, then come back.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring the leg back to the center, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, low shoulders, straight gaze.

C079.nom: Abductor stretching with support against a wall
contraintes: Align the trunk with the raised leg
variantes: Foot flat against the wall or leg bent

consignes.Positionnement: Stand sideways to the wall with your outside leg raised and resting against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Slightly push the hip outwards to accentuate the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release, bring your leg back to the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the posture, exhale to release.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed, pelvis neutral.

C080.nom: Lying ankle over knee glute stretch
contraintes: Keep your head on the ground
variantes: With hands behind the thigh or on the shin
With strap to grab the leg

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, bend one leg and place the ankle of the other leg on your knee.
consignes.Mouvement: Grab the thigh of the leg that remains on the ground and gently bring it back towards you.
consignes.Retour: Release the pressure, place your feet on the ground and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply, exhale to release into the stretch.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders on the ground, pelvis stable, neck relaxed.

C081.nom: Seated crossed knee glute stretch with twist
contraintes: Do not sag in the twist
variantes: Arm supported behind or hooked on the knee
Opposite knee flexed or straight depending on the amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with one leg straight, the other bent on top with your foot outside your knee.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your torso towards the bent leg, opposite arm supporting or twisting.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale to accompany the twist, inhale to lengthen the spine.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis anchored, shoulders relaxed.

C082.nom: Stretching glutes on the floor in pigeon position
variantes: With bust straightened or lying on the forearm
With support under the buttock to reduce tension

consignes.Positionnement: From a quadrupedal position, bring one leg bent in front of you, the other stretched back.
consignes.Mouvement: Place your pelvis on the floor, adjust your front leg, lean forward or stay straight.
consignes.Retour: Push on the arms to return to quadrupedal position, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale to lengthen, exhale to release.
consignes.Posture: Hips parallel to the floor, shoulders relaxed.

C083.nom: Stretching glutes standing with bent leg on support
contraintes: Do not round your back when leaning
variantes: With forward flexion of the bust
With hand support on the knee

consignes.Positionnement: Place one leg bent on a bench, ankle supported, knee out.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt your torso forward to accentuate the stretch in the buttock of the raised leg.
consignes.Retour: Stand up and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the descent, inhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed, pelvis facing the support.

C084.nom: Gluteal stretching with TRX or straps
variantes: Foot in the strap or leg bent in external support

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the TRX with one leg bent and externally rotated, placed in the strap.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower your hips back, keeping the opposite leg bent for balance.
consignes.Retour: Straighten up by pushing on the supporting leg.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, hips aligned, arms active.

contraintes: Keep the front knee well oriented
variantes: With bust straightened or lying on the elbows
Support on a block under hand for balance

consignes.Positionnement: From a lunge position, cross your front leg diagonally in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower your pelvis toward the floor while keeping your back leg straight.
consignes.Retour: Lean on your hands to come back and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale to release into the position, inhale to maintain openness.
consignes.Posture: Back extended, hips aligned, shoulders low.

C086.nom: Psoas stretching in low lunge with retroversion of the pelvis
contraintes: Maintain active retroversion of the pelvis
variantes: With arm raised on the stretched side
With torso rotation to accentuate stretching

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in a low lunge, back knee on the floor, front knee bent at 90°.
consignes.Mouvement: Retrovert the pelvis (tuck in the buttocks), push the hips slightly forward.
consignes.Retour: Bring your pelvis back and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the posture, exhale to release tension.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis engaged, gaze forward.

C087.nom: Psoas stretch in lunge with raised arm and lateral tilt
variantes: With torso rotation
With arm stretched back

consignes.Positionnement: Low lunge, arm on the extended side raised above the head.
consignes.Mouvement: Lean sideways to the opposite side to increase the psoas stretch.
consignes.Retour: Return to center, rest your arm and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale to lengthen, exhale into the inclination.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis retroverted, shoulders relaxed.

C088.nom: Psoas Stretch Standing Rear Leg Raised
contraintes: Keep the pelvis neutral or slightly retroverted
variantes: Arm raised to lengthen the anterior chain
Optional side tilt

consignes.Positionnement: Place one back leg bent on a support (bench), the other leg forward in a lunge.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down slowly, pushing your hips forward while keeping your torso straight.
consignes.Retour: Come up slowly, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the descent, inhale on the ascent.
consignes.Posture: Long back, square hips, stable balance.

C089.nom: Psoas stretching on Swiss ball or bench
variantes: Arms alongside the body or stretched back
With crossed legs for more relaxation

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on a Swiss ball or a bench, legs relaxed towards the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Allow the hips to open gradually without forcing.
consignes.Retour: Bring your legs back one after the other, swing to the side to exit.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly and deeply, releasing with each exhalation.
consignes.Posture: Back supported, neck long, arms relaxed.

C090.nom: Psoas stretching with TRX or straps
variantes: Raised arms or integrated lateral movement
Heel on the ground or raised depending on the amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX handles, one leg back in a lunge, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly move your hips forward while keeping your torso straight.
consignes.Retour: Bring your hips back and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale to come back.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders stable, pelvis retroverted, gaze fixed.

C091.nom: Lumbar stretch lying knees to chest
contraintes: Do not force the crushing of the lower back
Keep your shoulders on the ground
variantes: One leg brought back at a time
With gentle tilting of the pelvis from side to side

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, bring both knees towards your chest.
consignes.Mouvement: Grasp the shins or the back of the thighs and pull gently without lifting the shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Gradually release your legs to the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply, releasing tension with each exhale.
consignes.Posture: Neck elongated, back relaxed, pelvis rested.

C092.nom: Lying lumbar stretch tilting the knees left-right
objectifs: Lateral mobility of the lower back
contraintes: Keep your shoulders in contact with the ground
variantes: Knees bent at 90° or placed on a cushion

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms crossed, knees bent, feet on the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your knees swing from side to side smoothly.
consignes.Retour: Bring your knees to the center between each side.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in the rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Back and shoulders relaxed, fluid movement.

C093.nom: Seated lumbar stretch in back roll
contraintes: Do not force the cervical spine
variantes: Arms relaxed between the legs or towards the ankles

consignes.Positionnement: Sit cross-legged or in a chair with your back straight at first.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently roll your back, vertebra by vertebra, forward, let your head and arms fall.
consignes.Retour: Straighten up slowly by straightening your back.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in the winding, inhale on the ascent.
consignes.Posture: Complete relaxation, shoulders relaxed, pelvis stable.

C094.nom: Lumbar stretching in cat position (round back on all fours)
variantes: Round back alone or coupled with the hollow position (hollow back/round back)

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, knees under your hips, hands under your shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Round your back by tucking your chin and pelvis to stretch your spine.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position or alternate with hollow back if desired.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the round back, inhale into the hollow back.
consignes.Posture: Fluid movement, mobile pelvis, gaze towards the navel.

C095.nom: Lumbar stretching in lateral tilt standing or sitting
variantes: Arms overhead or to the side

consignes.Positionnement: Stand or sit, arm raised above the head on the opposite side of the tilt.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt the trunk to the side without tipping forward or backward.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the inclination, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Elongated spine, low shoulders, stable hips.

C096.nom: Lumbar stretching lying on a Swiss ball or roller
variantes: Arms open in a cross or support
Legs bent or straight

consignes.Positionnement: Lie crosswise on a Swiss ball or roller, with your lower back well supported.
consignes.Mouvement: Relax your back around the support, letting your arms open.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arms back, gently roll to the side to exit.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, abdominal breathing.
consignes.Posture: Neck aligned, trunk relaxed, support distributed.

C097.nom: Upper back stretch with arms stretched across the chest
objectifs: Stretching the middle trapezius and rhomboids
contraintes: Do not shrug the stretched shoulder
variantes: Arm more or less outstretched
With gentle rotation of the neck to the opposite side

consignes.Positionnement: Stand or sit, extend one arm in front of you across your chest.
consignes.Mouvement: With your other arm, gently pull toward you to stretch the back of your shoulder and upper back.
consignes.Retour: Release the pressure, change arms.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during tension, inhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, gaze straight.

C098.nom: Stretching upper back arms crossed forward round back
contraintes: Completely relax your neck and arms
variantes: Arms crossed or hands intertwined

consignes.Positionnement: Cross your arms in front of you at shoulder height, palms facing you.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently roll your back, pushing your arms far in front to stretch your upper back.
consignes.Retour: Straighten yourself vertebra by vertebra.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you round your back, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder blades apart, neck relaxed, back rounded.

C099.nom: Upper back stretch with arms extended far in front (shoulder blades distanced)
C099.type: Segmented stretching on all fours or supported
contraintes: Keep your butt toward your heels
variantes: With hands on a support for more amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself on your knees, arms extended far in front on the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Push your hands far forward to spread your shoulder blades, letting your forehead rest on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Gently bring your hands back and stand up.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply, releasing tension as you exhale.
consignes.Posture: Back extended, arms active, shoulders low.

C100.nom: Upper back stretch against a wall with arms outstretched
variantes: Y or T arm depending on the desired angle

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing a wall, arms extended upwards and placed flat.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your hips back slightly and push your chest toward the floor to create a back opening.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the stretch, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Arms straight, back aligned, neck relaxed.

C101.nom: Upper back stretching with TRX or elastic
variantes: Sitting or standing position
With lowering of the shoulders

consignes.Positionnement: Pull the TRX or the elastic arm straight back or to the side.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your arms back and gently push your ribcage forward.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in tension, inhale in return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, core engaged, shoulders low.

C102.nom: Upper back stretch seated arms extended forward round back
contraintes: Do not force the cervical spine
variantes: Arms placed on a support or suspended

consignes.Positionnement: Sit cross-legged or on a chair, arms extended far in front at shoulder height.
consignes.Mouvement: Curl your upper back while moving your arms forward, look towards the navel.
consignes.Retour: Unwind slowly to come back straight.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the winding, inhale into the straightening.
consignes.Posture: Rounded back, relaxed shoulders, long neck.

C103.nom: Cobra abdominal stretch on the floor
contraintes: Do not arch your lower back excessively
variantes: Arms fully extended or partially flexed
With slight trunk rotation

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your stomach, hands under your shoulders, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently push on the arms to straighten the bust and open the front of the body.
consignes.Retour: Slowly come back down and release your whole body to the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going up, exhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis on the ground, shoulders away from the ears, gaze forward or slightly upwards.

C104.nom: Stretching abdominals in extension on Swiss ball
objectifs: Passive opening of the abdominal strap
variantes: Arms relaxed or stretched back

consignes.Positionnement: Lie crosswise on a Swiss ball with your lower back supported.
consignes.Mouvement: Allow the trunk to open by releasing the arms backwards.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arms back, swing to the side to come back.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply while opening your rib cage.
consignes.Posture: Back relaxed, legs stable, head aligned.

objectifs: Full opening of the front of the body
variantes: Arms straight or bent
Elevated with support under the hands

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, hands under your shoulders, feet flat.
consignes.Mouvement: Push on the arms and feet to raise the pelvis and arch the back in a bridge.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly by unwinding the column.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going up, exhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders engaged, gaze towards the ground, pelvis high.

C106.nom: Abdominal stretching with TRX or straps
variantes: Arms more or less apart

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the TRX, arms extended above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently lean your torso forward, keeping your core engaged.
consignes.Retour: Bring the trunk back to vertical in a controlled manner.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in the extension, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, arms straight, legs slightly bent.

C107.nom: Lying twist abdominal stretch (twist on the floor)
contraintes: Shoulders in contact with the ground
variantes: With arms crossed or opposite hand on the knee

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms crossed, right knee bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the right knee to the left, gently placing it on the ground. Keep your shoulders on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Bring the knee to the center, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the twist, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Relaxed trunk, gaze towards the opposite arm.

C108.nom: Oblique stretching in lateral tilt seated or standing
variantes: Opposite arm raised overhead or to the side

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or stand with your right arm raised above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt your torso to the left, without turning your torso.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the inclination, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, shoulders aligned.

C109.nom: Stretching Obliques Standing Arms Above Head
variantes: With wrist grip to accentuate the stretch

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your right arm raised above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently lean to the left while maintaining arm extension.
consignes.Retour: Return to an upright position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale to lengthen, exhale into the inclination.
consignes.Posture: Spine elongated, shoulders relaxed.

C110.nom: Oblique stretching on Swiss ball in lateral tilt
variantes: Arm stretched above head

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side on a Swiss ball, legs apart for stability.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your trunk curve laterally around the ball, opposite arm relaxed.
consignes.Retour: Lean on your legs to come back.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply to accompany relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Trunk relaxed, head aligned, pelvis stable.

variantes: With arms on the stomach or arms crossed

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, legs bent, arms resting on your abdomen.
consignes.Mouvement: Inhale deeply, expanding your abdomen, then exhale slowly, pulling your stomach in slightly.
consignes.Retour: Repeat several breathing cycles while remaining relaxed.
consignes.Respiration: Long, deep and nasal.
consignes.Posture: Back on the ground, pelvis neutral, shoulders relaxed.

C112.nom: Stretching pectorals standing with arms against a wall
contraintes: Do not excessively twist the bust
variantes: Arm at 90° or arm extended according to the desired angle

consignes.Positionnement: Stand next to a wall with your right arm extended horizontally and your hand against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently turn your trunk to the left to feel the stretch in your right pectoral.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while turning, inhale while maintaining the position.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, arms at shoulder height.

C113.nom: Y-arm pectoral stretch against a wall
objectifs: Stretching the upper fibers of the pectoralis major
contraintes: Do not arch your lower back
variantes: Arm diagonally up or more open

consignes.Positionnement: Standing facing a wall, place one arm diagonally upward (in a Y shape) against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your torso slightly in the opposite direction to feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arm back and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale into the opening, exhale into the posture.
consignes.Posture: Arm at 120°, shoulder blade lowered.

C114.nom: Stretching pectoral arms in L against a wall
contraintes: Align the forearm at shoulder height
variantes: More or less close to the wall

consignes.Positionnement: Place your arm bent in an L shape against a wall (shoulder and elbow at 90°).
consignes.Mouvement: Gently rotate the torso in the direction opposite to the stretched shoulder.
consignes.Retour: Release the rotation and change arms.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and release with each exhale.
consignes.Posture: Elbow at shoulder height, shoulder blade down.

C115.nom: Stretching pectorals with arms crossed (facing the ground)
variantes: Arms at shoulder height or slightly V-shaped

consignes.Positionnement: Lie face down on the floor, arms crossed at shoulder height.
consignes.Mouvement: Push lightly with the other hand to turn the torso, opposite leg on top.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to your stomach.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in the opening, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder stretched in contact with the ground, trunk relaxed.

C116.nom: Pectoral stretching on Swiss ball or roller
variantes: T, V or Y arm

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on the roller or Swiss ball, arms open on each side.
consignes.Mouvement: Release your arms and let your shoulders open naturally.
consignes.Retour: Bring your arms back then gently roll to the side.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, deep breathing to promote relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Open chest, stable pelvis, relaxed neck.

C117.nom: Bilateral pectoral stretching in a door
variantes: Arms at different angles (T, Y, L)

consignes.Positionnement: Place both arms against the edges of a door, elbows at 90° or arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly move your torso forward until you feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Slowly step back out of the pose.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while moving forward, inhale while holding.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, stable trunk, straight gaze.

C118.nom: Stretching triceps arm bent behind the head
contraintes: Do not arch your lower back
variantes: With elbow or wrist grip
With lateral tilt

consignes.Positionnement: Place your right arm bent behind your head, hand between your shoulder blades.
consignes.Mouvement: Grasp the right elbow with your left hand and gently pull back and down.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release, then switch arms.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into tension, inhale into relaxation.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, neck aligned, stomach engaged.

C119.nom: Triceps stretch arms behind the head with lateral tilt
variantes: With or without elbow support

consignes.Positionnement: Right arm bent behind the head, left hand on the right elbow.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt your torso to the left, without twisting your torso.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the inclination, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, back elongated, gaze straight.

C120.nom: Stretching triceps against a wall with bent arm
variantes: With slight torso rotation

consignes.Positionnement: Right arm bent and elbow placed against a wall next to the head.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring your chest forward slightly to accentuate the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Back away slowly, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Expires each time it is powered up.
consignes.Posture: Straight bust, low shoulders.

C121.nom: Triceps stretching with TRX or flexed arm elastic
variantes: Arm more or less bent

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX or elastic arm bent behind your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Step back slightly to create tension that opens the shoulder and triceps.
consignes.Retour: Release gently.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in the posture.
consignes.Posture: Trunk engaged, pelvis stable, arm framing the ear.

C122.nom: Hand-to-hand triceps stretch behind the back
variantes: With or without accessories

consignes.Positionnement: Place one arm behind your head and the other behind your back, hands trying to meet.
consignes.Mouvement: Grab your hands or use a towel to connect the two.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while maintaining the position.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed.

C123.nom: Stretching biceps with arms outstretched behind the back
variantes: With towel or strap if the hands do not meet
Arms more or less raised

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your hands intertwined behind your back, arms extended.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull your arms back and down to feel the stretch in the front of your arms.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the tension and return to the neutral position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while stretching, inhale while maintaining the position.
consignes.Posture: Open chest, low shoulders, tucked chin.

C124.nom: Stretching biceps palm to wall, fingers down
variantes: Arm more or less outstretched

consignes.Positionnement: Place your hand flat on a wall, arm extended, fingers down.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your torso slightly in the opposite direction.
consignes.Retour: Release and change arms.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each release.
consignes.Posture: Chest open, shoulders aligned.

C125.nom: Stretching biceps arms crosswise against a wall or frame
contraintes: Arms at shoulder height or slightly lower
variantes: T-arm or V-arm

consignes.Positionnement: Place both arms outstretched on a wall or frame at shoulder height.
consignes.Mouvement: Move your torso forward slightly to feel the tension in the front of your arms.
consignes.Retour: Back away slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while moving forward, inhale in posture.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, neutral spine.

C126.nom: Stretching arm biceps on inclined support
variantes: Arm in wide or moderate opening

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on an inclined support, arms relaxed at your sides, palms facing up.
consignes.Mouvement: Allow the arms to gradually open under the effect of gravity.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your arms back before standing up.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, deep breathing.
consignes.Posture: Back braced, chest open, shoulders relaxed.

C127.nom: Biceps stretching with TRX or elastic
variantes: Arms at shoulder height or diagonally

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX handles or the elastic, arms extended back.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward slowly to feel the stretch in the front of the arms.
consignes.Retour: Back away slowly to release.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into posture, inhale back.
consignes.Posture: Arms outstretched, core engaged, gaze ahead.

C128.nom: Forearm flexor stretch – fingers towards the ground, arm extended
variantes: Fingers facing the floor or slightly inward

consignes.Positionnement: Extend your right arm in front of you, palm forward, fingers down.
consignes.Mouvement: With your left hand, grab your right fingers and gently pull towards you.
consignes.Retour: Release slowly then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each pull, inhale as you release.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, arms straight.

C129.nom: Forearm extensor stretch – fingers up, arm extended
objectifs: Stretching the extensor muscles of the forearm
variantes: Hand relaxed or fingers spread

consignes.Positionnement: Right arm extended in front of you, palm facing you, fingers up.
consignes.Mouvement: With your left hand, gently pull your right fingers toward you.
consignes.Retour: Release then change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each pull, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed.

C130.nom: Forearm stretch against a wall – palm flat
contraintes: Fingers down or to the side
variantes: Flexed arm or straight arm

consignes.Positionnement: Place your palm against the wall, arm straight or slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate the body slightly to accentuate the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Release slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder low, arm well aligned.

C131.nom: Forearm stretch on the floor – hands backwards
contraintes: Hands turned back, fingers on the ground
variantes: More or less weight on the hands

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you, palms on the floor, fingers facing back.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly move your pelvis back to feel the stretch.
consignes.Retour: Move forward slightly to release.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, relaxed breathing.
consignes.Posture: Arms straight or semi-flexed, shoulders low.

C132.nom: Forearm stretching with TRX or elastic
objectifs: Assisted stretching of flexors or extensors
variantes: Palm facing forward (flexors) or toward you (extensors)

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the TRX or an elastic band with your arm outstretched, palm in the chosen orientation.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward slowly or pull lightly on the elastic to create tension.
consignes.Retour: Release gradually.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in neutral position, exhale while stretching.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, elbow stable, arms in line.

C133.nom: Neck stretch in assisted lateral tilt
objectifs: Reduction of accumulated tension in the neck
variantes: With or without hand assistance
Sitting on a chair or cross-legged

consignes.Positionnement: Stand straight, left arm at your side, right hand placed on the left side of the head.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently pull your head to the right to feel the stretch on the left side of your neck.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale into the stretch, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed, gaze fixed ahead.

C134.nom: Neck stretch in forward flexion – chin towards the chest
contraintes: Do not round your upper back
variantes: With or without hand support on the back of the head

consignes.Positionnement: Stand up straight, look forward, then slowly tilt your head forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Let your chin drop towards your chest without forcing it.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to neutral position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you return, exhale as you stretch.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low.

C135.nom: Neck stretch in gentle rotation – looking over the shoulder
variantes: With hold of a few seconds at each end

consignes.Positionnement: Stand up straight, look ahead.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly turn your head to the right to look over your shoulder, then to the left.
consignes.Retour: Return to center between each rotation.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale in rotation, inhale in the center.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, chin aligned.

C136.nom: Neck extension stretch – look towards the ceiling
variantes: With arms behind the back to stabilize the shoulders

consignes.Positionnement: Sit up straight, look forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly tilt your head back, look at the ceiling.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your head back to horizontal.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the return, exhale in the opening.
consignes.Posture: Stable trunk, relaxed shoulders.

C137.nom: Upper trapezius stretch – tilt + shoulder down
contraintes: Shoulder well lowered on the stretched side
variantes: Arm behind the back or pulled by a strap

consignes.Positionnement: Tilt your head to the right, left arm down or behind your back.
consignes.Mouvement: Use the right hand to gently pull the head and increase the tilt.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the inclination, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders relaxed.

C138.nom: Stretching neck tilt with arms behind the back
objectifs: Deep stretch on the opposite side of the neck
variantes: With towel to hold the arm

consignes.Positionnement: Pull your left arm behind your back and tilt your head to the right.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the gentle inclination without forcing.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your head back, change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply in stillness.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, chin tucked.

C139.nom: Ankle mobility – Unilateral circle in support
variantes: Circle resting on a wall
With support on a bar for balance

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on one leg, the other slightly off the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform slow circles with the ankle of the raised leg, back and forth.
consignes.Retour: Rest your leg and change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and regularly during exercise.
consignes.Posture: Keep your torso straight and fix a point in front of you for balance.

C140.nom: Ankle mobility – Circle in wall support
variantes: Without wall support
With support on a stick or chair

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with one hand against a wall for balance, the other leg slightly off the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Make slow circles with the ankle in one direction, then the other.
consignes.Retour: Rest the leg and perform the movement on the other side.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while lifting your foot, exhale at the end of the circle.
consignes.Posture: Maintain a straight and relaxed torso, look forward.

C141.nom: Ankle mobility – Active dorsiflexion against a wall
variantes: With load on the knee to accentuate flexion
Without wall, with mark on the ground

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot a few centimeters from a wall, the other leg back (lunge position).
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly advance your knee toward the wall without lifting your heel, then move back to the initial position.
consignes.Retour: Repeat several times then switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while stepping back, exhale slowly while bending.
consignes.Posture: Keep your hips facing the wall, your back straight and your heel in good contact with the ground.

C142.nom: Ankle mobility – Dorsal flexion with load on the knee
variantes: With elastic around the knee
Leaning against a wall
Without load

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a forward lunge or on your knees, with a disc placed on the knee of the front leg.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly push the knee forward, keeping the heel on the ground, the load accompanies the movement.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, then switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bending, inhale back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your hips stable and your back straight throughout the movement.

C143.nom: Ankle mobility – Dorsal flexion with elastic
variantes: Without elastic
With load on the knee

consignes.Positionnement: Secure a rubber band around a stable support behind you and wrap it around the top of your foot or ankle.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently advance the knee forward, the elastic provides slight posterior resistance.
consignes.Retour: Return to the initial position in a controlled manner.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way out, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: The heel must always remain in contact with the ground.

C144.nom: Ankle mobility – Kneeling dorsiflexion against support
objectifs: Dorsal flexion work without standing support
variantes: With load on the knee
Without support, in front slot

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself on your knees with your front foot close to a wall or vertical bench.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly advance the knee towards the support, without lifting the heel.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position and repeat.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you move forward, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Keep your spine aligned and your shoulders relaxed.

C145.nom: Ankle mobility – Dorsal flexion without wall with reference on the ground
variantes: With load on the knee
With elastic

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot flat on the ground, visual cue approximately 10 cm in front of the toes.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly advance your knee towards the mark without lifting your heel.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position and repeat.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way out, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your gaze straight, pelvis facing, without compensation.

objectifs: Prevention of external and internal sprains
variantes: In a seated position
With mini resistance band

consignes.Positionnement: Stand or sit, foot flat on the ground, legs relaxed.
consignes.Mouvement: Gently tilt the ankle outwards (eversion), then inwards (inversion), without lifting the foot from the ground.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to center between each movement.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe normally and release tension.
consignes.Posture: Keep your upper body stable and relaxed.

C147.nom: Ankle mobility – Lateral tilts with mini-band
variantes: Without elastic
On unstable plane

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or stand with a mini-band placed around your feet or ankles depending on the variant.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly move the forefoot outward against resistance, then return to center. Repeat on the other side.
consignes.Retour: Release gently with each repetition.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when leaving, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: The knee remains stable, only the foot tilts.

C148.nom: Ankle mobility – Lateral inclinations on unstable plane
variantes: With elastic
