Without unstable support (ground)

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on an unstable surface with your feet hip-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly tilt one foot out and then in, keeping the other foot steady.
consignes.Retour: Repeat the movement alternating left/right.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each inclination, inhale as you return to the center.
consignes.Posture: Keep a fixed gaze, abs engaged and pelvis aligned.

C149.nom: Knee mobility – active flexion-extension in a seated position
variantes: With light load on the foot
With elastic for gentle resistance

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the edge of a chair, feet flat on the floor, back straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly straighten one leg until almost fully extended, then gently bend it back.
consignes.Retour: Return the leg to the initial position and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when extending, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Keep the trunk still, shoulders relaxed.

C150.nom: Knee mobility – Flexion-extension with light load
objectifs: Stimulation of mobility with muscle activation
variantes: Without load
With elastic

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the edge of a chair with a weight attached to your foot or held above your ankle.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly straighten your leg as you lift the weight, then bend back in a controlled manner.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position, then switch legs.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the extension, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, shoulders relaxed, look forward.

variantes: Without elastic
With light load

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the edge of a chair with a rubber band tied between your foot and an anchor point behind you.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch your leg against the resistance of the elastic, then slowly return.
consignes.Retour: Return your foot to the ground and repeat on the other side.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning your torso.

C152.nom: Knee mobility – Sliding of the foot on the ground in a seated position
variantes: With light load on the thigh
With elastic band for assistance

consignes.Positionnement: Sit in a chair with both feet flat on a slippery surface (socks or towel underfoot).
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly slide one foot toward you (knee flexion), then extend the leg again.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position smoothly, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while extending, exhale while bringing the foot back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back straight, shoulders relaxed, look straight ahead.

C153.nom: Knee mobility – Assisted gliding with load on the thigh
objectifs: Facilitating knee flexion with gravity assistance
variantes: Without load
With manual or elastic assistance

consignes.Positionnement: Sit in a chair with your foot on a towel or slippery surface. Place a light weight on the thigh of the mobilized side.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the foot slide towards you, the load encourages gentle flexion of the knee.
consignes.Retour: Redeploy the leg slowly while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on flexion, inhale on extension.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward.

C154.nom: Knee mobility – Assisted sliding with elastic band
variantes: Without tape
With load on the thigh

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a chair with an elastic band placed around the foot to be mobilized and held with your hands.
consignes.Mouvement: Lightly pull the band to slide the foot towards you gently.
consignes.Retour: Allow the leg to return to extension without completely releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when bending, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Maintain a straight torso, shoulders low.

contraintes: Front knee aligned with the foot
variantes: Assisted lunge with support on a support
Static lunge in hold

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with one foot forward and the other behind (classic lunge position).
consignes.Mouvement: Go down slowly by bending both knees, without letting the front knee go beyond the toes.
consignes.Retour: Come back up by pushing through the front leg, then switch sides after reps.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Keep your torso straight and your hips facing forward.

variantes: With block under the hands for greater comfort
With small ankle weight

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself on all fours on the mat, knees under your hips, hands under your shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly bring one heel towards the buttock (flexion), then extend the leg backwards without arching your back.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position and alternate sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while bending, exhale while extending.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, gaze towards the ground, abdominals engaged.

C157.nom: Knee mobility – Opening-closing in external rotation
variantes: Manual leg assistance
With band around the knee as a guide

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back or sit on the floor with your legs bent and your feet flat on the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly open one knee outwards (abduction), let it descend without taking off the other foot, then close gently.
consignes.Retour: Return the knee to the central position, then switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale when opening, exhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back on the ground or straight if seated, pelvis stable.

objectifs: Improved circular mobility of the hip
variantes: Reverse direction
With light load on the ankle
Resting on the forearms

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift one knee and make a large, slow circle with your hip, outwards, then inwards.
consignes.Retour: Rest the knee after a few repetitions and switch sides.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way up, exhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Trunk still, look at the ground, abs engaged.

C159.nom: Hip mobility – Open knee in butterfly sitting (balancer)
variantes: With gentle elbow push
With block under the knees

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a mat, soles of your feet together (butterfly position), knees open outwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Make small up and down movements with your knees, keeping your back straight.
consignes.Retour: Stay in the low position for a few seconds before releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way up, exhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Keep your spine lengthened and your shoulders relaxed.

variantes: With hand support behind
Hands-free (more advanced)

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor, legs bent at 90°, knees on each side (90/90 position).
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly swing both knees to the other side, keeping your feet in the same place.
consignes.Retour: Return to the center and switch to the other side.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the tilt, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back straight, hands can be placed behind for balance.

C161.nom: Hip mobility – Standing knee raise (active control)
variantes: With support against a wall
Without shoes for work feet

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, arms at your sides, body weight distributed on one foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly raise the opposite knee to hip height (90°) without bending your torso.
consignes.Retour: Go back down while controlling, then change sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Look straight ahead, shoulders relaxed, support foot anchored.

C162.nom: Thoracic mobility – Quadrupedal rotation (thread the needle)
contraintes: Rotation initiated by the upper back
variantes: With support on a block
With fully extended arm

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate one arm under the other, then return to the initial position by opening the arm towards the sky.
consignes.Retour: Repeat several times on one side before switching.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the descent, inhale on the opening.
consignes.Posture: Keep your hips stable, your gaze follows your arm.

C163.nom: Thoracic mobility – Opening in decubitus position with crossed arms (open book)
variantes: With cushion under the head
With knee blocked by a ball or block

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side, legs bent, arms extended one over the other at shoulder height.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly open your upper arm in the opposite direction, as if you were opening a book, following with your gaze.
consignes.Retour: Return to the initial position smoothly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Knees remain together on the ground, pelvis stable.

C164.nom: Thoracic mobility – Seated rotation with arms crossed
variantes: With a stick on my shoulders
Arms crossed on the shoulders

consignes.Positionnement: Sit cross-legged or on a chair, back straight, arms stretched out crosswise at shoulder height.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate your upper torso to the right, then to the left, without moving your pelvis.
consignes.Retour: Return to center after each rotation.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Look straight ahead, shoulders down, abs engaged.

C165.nom: Thoracic mobility – Extension on foam roller
objectifs: Controlled extension of the thoracic spine
contraintes: Foam roller positioned at the level of the shoulder blades
variantes: Arms crossed
Arms stretched above head

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor. Place the foam roller perpendicularly under your upper back (thoracic level).
consignes.Mouvement: Perform a gentle extension, letting your ribcage open above the roller, then return to neutral.
consignes.Retour: Repeat the movement or maintain the position depending on the goal.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale deeply as you open, exhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Keep your abs engaged and your neck relaxed.

C166.nom: Shoulder mobility – Standing shoulder circles (scapular control)
objectifs: Improved postural control of the shoulders
variantes: Arms stretched forward
With a stick behind his back

consignes.Positionnement: Stand upright, arms relaxed alongside your body or extended forward depending on the variation.
consignes.Mouvement: Make slow, wide shoulder circles forward, then back.
consignes.Retour: Perform several repetitions in each direction.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the rise, exhale on the descent of the movement.
consignes.Posture: Head aligned, spine straight, pelvis neutral.

C167.nom: Shoulder mobility – Arm circles extended forward
variantes: With small weight in each hand
In seated position for scapular focus

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your arms outstretched in front of you at shoulder height, palms facing the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Make small circles forward, then backward, without bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Come back with your arms relaxed between sets.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the movement, inhale when relaxing.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, stomach tucked in, back straight.

C168.nom: Shoulder mobility – Circles with stick behind the back
objectifs: Relaxation of the trapezius and posterior deltoids
Gentle stimulation of the scapula fixators
variantes: By sitting against a wall for more control
With towel instead of stick

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a stick behind your back with both hands, arms relaxed.
consignes.Mouvement: Make small circles with your shoulders forward, then back, keeping the stick in contact with your lower back.
consignes.Retour: Relax between sets.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while raising your shoulders, exhale while lowering them.
consignes.Posture: Head aligned, abs engaged, pelvis neutral.

C169.nom: Shoulder mobility – External rotation against a wall
contraintes: Back and head in contact with the wall
variantes: Without wall with elastic band
With towel under arm

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your back to the wall, arm bent at 90°, elbow glued to the body, forearm parallel to the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform an external rotation by slowly bringing the hand outwards, while keeping the elbow glued.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position and repeat.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Head, back and buttocks in contact with the wall, shoulder blades stabilized.

C170.nom: Shoulder mobility – Wall slides against a wall
objectifs: Gentle activation of the rotator cuff
contraintes: Lower back and head stuck to the wall
variantes: With elastic around the cuffs
Y or W shaped arm

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with your back to the wall, arms bent at 90°, hands at ear level.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly slide your arms up, keeping contact with the wall, then come back down.
consignes.Retour: Repeat several times.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way up, exhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Engaged abs, no excessive arching.

objectifs: Functional activation of the scapula fixators
C171.type: Mobility on the ground with outstretched arms
variantes: With light dumbbells
Opposite arm raised with external rotation

consignes.Positionnement: Get on all fours, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lift one arm out in front of you to shoulder height, then return to the ground.
consignes.Retour: Alternate arms or do all reps on one side.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Look towards the ground, abs engaged, pelvis still.

C172.nom: Shoulder mobility – Scapular sliding with arms outstretched on the wall
contraintes: Back and pelvis in contact with the wall
variantes: With small elastic around the cuffs
In a seated position for more control

consignes.Positionnement: Place your back to the wall, arms extended at shoulder height, palms facing forward or the wall depending on comfort.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly slide your arms up, keeping contact with the wall, then slowly lower back down.
consignes.Retour: Repeat several times, without arching.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way up, exhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Abs engaged, head straight, shoulder blades active.

C173.nom: Shoulder mobility – Internal rotation in lateral decubitus
variantes: Without load
With towel between elbow and side

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side, upper arm bent at 90°, elbow next to the body, forearm perpendicular.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly bring your hand towards the ground in internal rotation, then come back up with control.
consignes.Retour: Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Head resting on the opposite arm, pelvis stable.

objectifs: Full mobility in internal and external rotation

With a small elastic band between the hands

consignes.Positionnement: Lie flat on your stomach, arms outstretched in front of you, palms facing the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly slide your arms across the floor in a swimming motion (circle), bringing your arms behind your back (palms toward the ceiling), then return to the front.
consignes.Retour: Connect movements fluidly.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way out, exhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your forehead on the ground, glutes relaxed.

objectifs: Improved overall shoulder range of motion

Sitting against a wall to limit lumbar compensation

consignes.Mouvement: Pass the stick over your head and behind your back in a controlled manner, then return to the front.
consignes.Retour: Performs the movement in both directions smoothly.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way up, exhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Feet hip width apart, back straight, abs engaged.

C176.nom: Wrist mobility – Circles supported on the ground
variantes: Wrists rotated backwards
One-sided circle

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on all fours, hands under your shoulders, fingers facing forward.

consignes.Retour: Changes direction of rotation after a few repetitions.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly and deeply throughout the movement.

consignes.Retour: Alternate between tension and release on each repetition.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going backwards, exhale while moving forward.
consignes.Posture: Arms straight, shoulders relaxed, back neutral.

C178.nom: Wrist mobility – Active rear weight flexions

Preparation for balances or movements on inverted supports

Arms slightly bent

consignes.Retour: Go back and then repeat the movement several times.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while moving forward, inhale while moving backward.
consignes.Posture: Avoid rolling your shoulders, relax your neck.

C179.nom: Wrist mobility – Back of hand support on the ground
